items.title: Alan Raph interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: Milt was absolutely wonderful. There’s nobody that doesn’t love Milt Hinton.

ctx.x: Milt was absolutely wonderful. There’s nobody that doesn’t love Milt Hinton. Just like Joe Wilder. There’s nobody that doesn’t love Joe. There are certain people that are around here that are just absolutely brilliant musicians and the nicest people in the world.
Right. They make you feel good to be with them.
